scope: Additive source-local final-evidence orchestration for the future Q-011 Section 5.4 production campaign. The component cross-binds a complete admitted 3x8 campaign matrix, exact AMR/fine pair coverage, retained production restart parity, the passing source-local numerical aggregate, and a separately accepted independent raw-artifact recomputation. It emits only a deterministic claim-candidate evidence manifest that remains pending named terminal external review.

input_contract.admitted_bundle_identities: exact canonical 24-cell 3-variant by 8-seed order with unique admission-result, attempt and raw-inventory SHA-256 bindings
input_contract.aggregate_analysis: exact q011_section54_source_local_numerical_qualification record with every attempt and pair gate passed, pending external review, and no final claim closure
input_contract.amr_fine_pair_coverage: one exact same-seed AMR/fine pair for each of the eight qualifying seeds
input_contract.restart_parity: retained production restart screen sourced from the preregistered first-seed AMR baseline with exact observed-commit sequence and passing deterministic continuation parity
input_contract.independent_recomputation: reviewed accepted independent raw-artifact recomputation bound to the exact aggregate and every attempt inventory, with production-helper imports forbidden and complete canonical metric-comparison coverage

output_contract.emission_policy: canonical JSON exclusive-create read-only file; overwrite forbidden

validation_coverage: expected campaign matrix and canonical order
admitted bundle identities and unique admission-result bindings
complete same-seed AMR/fine pair coverage and passing residual gates
retained first-seed AMR production restart parity and observed-commit sequence
independent script, environment, raw-input inventories, metric table and accepted recompute reviewer disposition
explicit rejection of claim-closure, execution, policy-mutation and claim-registry authority
remaining_gates: execute and retain the registered Q-011 production campaign
produce admitted identities, passing aggregate output and independent raw-artifact recomputation from the immutable production evidence
run this orchestrator on those exact retained records and freeze the resulting claim-candidate manifest
promote any claim only through a separate reviewed claim-registry process
limitations: This component does not inspect or discover raw simulation artifacts; upstream admission and numerical analyzers retain that responsibility.
An accepted independent-recompute review is distinct from the still-pending terminal external review of the claim candidate.
The emitted manifest closes no Q-011 or claim-registry gate and authorizes no Frontier execution or policy change.
